subject: general
question: What is the range of composite scores achieved by Union Territories (UTs) in the SDG India Index 2023-24?
solution:
The correct answer is __**65 to 77**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Sustainable Development Goals (SDG) India Index 2023-24 assesses the performance of states and Union Territories (UTs) based on their progress toward achieving the United Nations SDGs.
 
• The composite scores for Union Territories in the SDG India Index 2023-24 range from **65 to 77**.
 
• Union Territories like Chandigarh and Puducherry are often among the top performers, reflecting higher development levels across multiple SDG indicators.
 
• The scores are calculated based on 17 SDGs, covering areas like health, education, gender equality, and climate action, among others.
 
• The SDG India Index serves as a critical tool for policymakers to identify areas requiring improvement and focus resources effectively.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs):** A set of 17 global goals established by the United Nations in 2015 to address key global challenges such as poverty, inequality, and climate change by 2030.
 
• **SDG India Index:** Launched by NITI Aayog in 2018, it is a localized version of the global SDG framework aimed at tracking India's progress on SDGs across states and UTs.
 
• **Scoring Mechanism:** States and UTs are scored on a scale of 0 to 100, with higher scores indicating better progress toward achieving the SDGs.
 
• **Categories in the Index:** The SDG India Index classifies states and UTs into four categories: Aspirant (0-49), Performer (50-64), Front Runner (65-99), and Achiever (100).
 
• **Policy Implication:** The index helps identify gaps in development and enables governments to prioritize interventions in lagging sectors or regions.
